questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: In Schedule 06 Question 1: According to Bernoulli's equation for steady, non-viscous, incompressible fluid flow along a horizontal streamline, what happens to fluid pressure where flow speed increases?
options: Pressure decreases in regions of higher flow speed
Pressure increases proportionally to the square of flow speed
Pressure remains perfectly invariant along any streamline
Pressure fluctuates inversely with fluid density
questions.correctAnswer: Pressure decreases in regions of higher flow speed
questions.solution: For horizontal streamline, P + 0.5 * rho * v^2 = constant. As v increases, 0.5*rho*v^2 increases, requiring static pressure P to decrease.
questions.sourceLocator: NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch 10 Sections & Exercises
